description: Labeled MCP server configs for the detection truth gate. Labels were written from the 2026-11-19 probe and from the rule that a critical requires observed tools, a declared tool on the tool list, or the short package and name allowlist. Lookalike names are not critical. Disabled entries count as configs and must not be scanned.
